messages:
maria: quick heads-up — i pushed a tiny docs PR that adds a snippet for exporting the trace-id from streaming responses. it was requested by infra so we can correlate client-side latency spikes.
jon: link? i'll take a look after stand.
mar ia: oops typo, re-posting: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/console/observability/trace-streaming (draft link) — the key example is how to set the `X-Trace-Id` header and attach it to each chunk.
tasha: can you paste the snippet inline? hard to see in the preview on mobile.
maria: sure — snippet in PR shows the server side emitting header on first chunk and the client reading it: ```js
// server (node/express streaming)
res.setHeader('X-Trace-Id', traceId)
const stream = createResponseStream()
for await (const chunk of stream) { res.write(chunk) }
res.end()
```
jon: looks good. do we have a python example too? some customers use aiohttp streaming.
maria: added a short python aiohttp snippet: ```py
# server (aiohttp)
resp = web.StreamResponse(status=200)
resp.headers['X-Trace-Id'] = trace_id
await resp.prepare(request)
for part in iter_parts():
    await resp.write(part)
await resp.write_eof()
```
alex: nit: can we show how to read the header on the client? i.e. browsers don't expose streaming response headers normally. maybe call out that server should also echo trace in the first data frame.
maria: good call — updated text to recommend both header + first-chunk JSON: `{"trace_id": "<id>"}` so SDKs can pick it up reliably.
docs-ci-bot: link-checker found 1 broken link in the PR: https://old.docs.redwood-inference.com/obsv/trace-old -> 404
maria: thanks bot — fixed the link target and pushed.
tasha: also left a tiny copy edit about 'latency correlation' wording, otherwise LGTM.
jon: i'll do a quick functional review — can someone add a unit test or verify the snippet runs? maybe add a CI smoke test that starts a tiny server and checks header+firstchunk parsing.
maria: added a `smoke/snippets/trace-stream` pytest that spins up aiohttp and asserts header + first JSON frame. pushed.
alex: test passed locally for me. removing the WIP tag.
tasha: approving in the docs repo.
jon: approved and merged. :tada:
maria: thanks all — will follow up if support surfaces any quirks.
